title: When the Oceans Rise
lyrics_original: When the oceans rise and thunders roar
I will soar with You above the storm
Father you are King over the flood
I will be still, know You are God
In quietness and trust     ||When the oceans||
In quietness and trust     ||When the oceans||

bible_verses.telugu: ఆయన తన రెక్కలతో నిన్ను కప్పును ఆయన రెక్కల క్రింద నీకు ఆశ్రయము కలుగును ఆయన సత్యము, కేడెమును డాలునై యున్నది.
bible_verses.english: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా ప్రళయజలములమీద ఆసీనుడాయెను యెహోవా నిత్యము రాజుగా ఆసీనుడైయున్నాడు.
bible_verses.english: The Lord sits enthroned over the flood; the Lord is enthroned as King forever.

bible_verses.telugu: ఊరకుండుడి నేనే దేవుడనని తెలిసికొనుడి అన్యజనులలో నేను మహోన్నతుడ నగుదును భూమిమీద నేను మహోన్నతుడ నగుదును
bible_verses.english: He says, "Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth."

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for being my safe refuge when the storms of life feel too strong to bear. Hide me under the shadow of Your wings and calm the anxieties within my heart. When the waters rise, remind me that You are still King over every flood. Help my soul to be still and trust in Your unfailing love and power today. In Jesus' name, Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for being my safe refuge when the storms of life feel too strong to bear. devotional.reflection_english: Life often brings unexpected storms that feel overwhelming, but we are never left to face them alone. This song invites us to take refuge under the shadow of God's wings, remembering that He reigns supreme over every rising tide. When chaos roars around us, we don't have to strive or panic; we can surrender our fears to the One who commands the winds and waves. May your heart find quiet confidence today, knowing that Jesus is King over every flood.
